label: Height

name: D
label: Depth
description: From the front to the wall

name: stock
label: Sheet
description: Material and thickness (bend radius and K-factor from the stock table)

name: profile
label: Rail profile
description: L (front face and a leg on the side) or C (with a return at the back of the leg)

name: railHoles
label: Rail holes
description: Square holes for M6 cage nuts, or 5 mm holes to tap M6 (only in 2 mm steel: thinner sheet holds too few threads; use rivnuts or clinch nuts there)

name: rear
label: Rear rails
description: A second pair of rails at the back, for deep equipment

name: door
label: Door
description: A vented door hinged at the left, or an open front

name: doorOpen
label: Door shown open
description: How far the door is shown open (only the view)

name: knock
label: Knock-outs
description: Cable entries in the lid and in the bottom, near the back

name: corner
label: Corners
description: How the flanges of the lid, the pan and the door meet at their corners: open (each flange ends at its bend), butt, overlap (the lid's and the pan's front flange and the door's side flanges cover the other flanges' ends) or miter; the sides' and the back's corners, inside the lid's, the pan's and the sides' bends, stay open

name: gap
label: Corner gap
description: The gap left at a closed corner: at least 0.4 mm (0.015 in, SendCutSend's least gap between flanges), a butt's less than the thickness
max: if(corner == 2, min(2 mm, t - 0.1 mm), 2 mm)

name: reliefShape
label: Corner relief
description: The relief cut at each corner of the flat pattern, R + t + 0.5 mm along each edge

name: gland
label: Gland size
description: Metric cable gland (EN 50262) the knock-outs take

title: 19-inch wall rack cabinet
description: A wall-mount 19-inch rack cabinet (EIA-310-D) of 6 to 15 U, 300 to 600 mm deep, every part bent from aluminium or steel sheet: two sides, a lid and a bottom pan with cable knock-outs, a back plate with wall-mount holes, front rails (and optionally rear rails) of L or C profile with square cage-nut holes or M6 holes on the EIA-310 pattern, and a vented door with hinge holes. Panels from the rack-panel Jig bolt onto its rails and fit between its sides. The flat pattern of each part, with its bend lines, is written by file.export with sheetMetal (see the README).
author: 3DCraft Jigs
